media_modal.output_format: Choose what you want to download
media_modal.editor_warning: Resolutions above 1080p come in {{codec}}, which video editors (Premiere, DaVinci…) can't open. Choose 1080p or lower to get H.264, or convert this file to H.264 with an online converter.

playlist_modal.output_label: Choose what you want to download from the playlist
playlist_modal.error_no_selection: Select at least one video to download

setup_modal.title: Welcome to FlowDownloader!
setup_modal.subtitle: Let's set up your initial download location

general.limit_info: You can increase the limit to scan entire playlists. To avoid slowing down your machine and YouTube server blocks (Error 429), Flow will process downloads intelligently, downloading {{n}} videos at a time.
general.cookies_info: If YouTube asks to 'confirm you're not a bot', pick the browser where you're logged in. Firefox is the most reliable on Windows.
general.cookies_file_info: Is Flow Downloader showing the 'confirm you're not a bot' error? Use a cookies.txt file: export your YouTube cookies (while logged in) with a browser extension such as 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY', then select the file here.
general.autopaste_info: When you open or focus the app, automatically fill the bar with a link copied to your clipboard.
general.concurrent_info: More at once is faster on good connections, but too many can make sites slow you down (error 429).

visual.film_grain_info: Cinematic grain with a light color fringe over the whole app. 0 turns it off.

shortcuts.info: Click a shortcut, then press the new key combination. Press Esc to cancel.
shortcuts.conflict: This combination is already used by “{{action}}”.

toast.open_error: Couldn't open the file or folder.
toast.ytdlp_uptodate: The download engine is already up to date.
toast.youtube_bot_check: YouTube blocked this request (bot check). Turn on Cookies in Settings → General.
toast.cookie_error: Couldn't read the browser's cookies. Try Firefox or a cookies.txt file.
toast.no_formats: No downloadable format for this video (it may be a live stream, premiere, or still processing).
toast.clipboard_autopaste: Link from your clipboard pasted automatically.
toast.err_age: Age-restricted: add your cookies in Settings to download it.
toast.err_private: Private or members-only: needs cookies from an account with access.
toast.err_live: This live stream or premiere hasn't started yet.
toast.err_unavailable: This video is unavailable or was removed.
toast.err_disk: Couldn't save the file. Check the folder and free disk space.
toast.err_ffmpeg: Couldn't finish the file. Try again or pick another format.
toast.err_network: Connection problem. Check your internet and try again.
toast.err_download: Download failed. Try again or update the engine in Settings.
toast.app_update_error: Couldn't check for or install the update.
toast.app_update_wait: Wait for the downloads to finish before updating.
toast.console_copied: Console diagnostics copied. Paste them when asking for help.
toast.screenshot_saved: Screenshot saved to <path>Pictures/Flow Downloader</path> and copied to the clipboard.

close_prompt.title: Close Flow Downloader?
close_prompt.message: If you close the app now, these downloads will be cancelled and their incomplete files deleted.
